name: Powerful part of n*(n+1): a(n) = A057521(n*(n+1)).
reference: Paul Erdős, Problems and results on number theoretic properties of consecutive integers and related questions. Proceedings of the Fifth Manitoba Conference on Numerical Mathematics (Univ. Manitoba, Winnipeg, Man., 1975) (1976), 25-44.
mathematica: a[n_] := Times @@ Power @@@ Select[ FactorInteger[n (n+1)], #[[2]] > 1 &]; Array[a, 77] (* _Giovanni Resta_, Oct 02 2025 *)
program: def a(n): return prod(p**e for p, e in factor(n*(n+1)) if e >= 2)
(PARI) a(n) = my(f=factor(n*(n+1))); for (i=1, #f~, if (f[i, 2]==1, f[i, 1]=1)); factorback(f); \\ _Michel Marcus_, Oct 02 2025
author: _Seewoo Lee_, Sep 26 2025
